title: Creamy Coconut Pastry
description: A sweet and creamy pastry dessert, perfect for warm weather or any occasion. This recipe combines the richness of coconut cream with the flakiness of pastry.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the coconut cream evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Dot the surface with low-fat cream and sprinkle with granulated sugar.
Fold the edges of the pastry up to create a crust, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
